content:
Hi all! I'm Klaus, one of @Michael Sammler's students. I recently worked on HeapLang-like tactics in Rocq and now want to learn some Lean metaprogramming: the missing HeapLang tactics look like a great place to start given I'm familiar with their Rocq counterparts.

I started with the low-hanging fruit pure wrappers as a warmup and submitted a PR (https://github.com/leanprover-community/iris-lean/pull/516). I'll tackle the heap tactics in the next days and would like to proceed with wp_apply and wp_smart_apply after that. Please ping me if anybody else is working on this so we can coordinate.
